from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document with its legally determined case cause."""
    document_id: str | None = Field(description="Identifier for the document (e.g., 'Document 1', '判决文书 1')")
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="Full title of the judgment document")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The legally determined case cause (案由) as stated in the document")
    legal_nature: str | None = Field(description="Legal nature of the case: 民事/刑事/行政")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
